description: A test file using Vitest to verify functions related to OpenClaw package publishing and runtime sidecar validation. It contains test cases for scenarios such as building install scenarios and collecting package errors.

methods.name: buildPublishedInstallScenarios
methods.description: Generates an array of installation scenarios based on the given version string, handling stable and correction releases.

methods.name: collectInstalledPackageErrors
methods.description: Analyzes the installed package details and returns an array of error messages related to version mismatches and missing runtime sidecars.
